question: Suppose $x^2+px+q=0$ has two real roots $\alpha$ and $\beta$ with $|\alpha|\ne|\beta|$. If $\alpha^4$ and $\beta^4$ are the roots of $x^2+rx+s=0$, then the equation $x^2-4qx+2q^2+r=0$ has

options.A: one positive and one negative root;

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
